rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone whose clothes look good and stylish.

example.english: They are well-dressed today and are going out for dim sum.
example.traditional: 佢今日着得好睇，去飲茶。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 tai2 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a fashionable, stylish, or cool look rather than merely neat clothing.

example.english: You look well-dressed and really cool today.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 jau5 jing4 wo3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the person is attractively dressed or looks especially nice.

example.english: You are so well-dressed that you will look great in photos.
example.traditional: 你着得好靚，影相一定上鏡。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoek3 dak1 hou2 leng3 jing2 soeng2 jat1 ding6 soeng5 geng3
